items.name: Z-Anatomy (internal anatomy: bones, muscles, nerves, vessels, organs)
items.attribution: "BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan" and "Z-Anatomy - The open source atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0"
items.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (models), as stated in the Z-Anatomy README; the template License.txt also requires the BodyParts3D CC BY-SA 2.1 JP credit and share-alike. models/body.glb and models/body_lo.glb are therefore distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
items.note: Modified: grouped by body system, aligned to the BodyParts3D frame (ICP, scale 0.9925), decimated per object, meshopt-compressed. Excluded for licence reasons: inner ear (CC BY-NC-SA), kidney (CC BY-NC), Brainder and white-matter brain (no licence stated). Fascia, bursae and inner spinal-cord tracts were also left out.

items.name: HuBMAP HRA 3D Reference Organ Set for Female v1.10 (female reproductive organs)
items.attribution: Browne, Kristen, and Heidi Schlehlein. 2026. 3D Reference Organ Set for Female, v1.10. https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM637.DWBM.744. Created using data from the Visible Human Dataset (National Library of Medicine).
items.note: Used: uterus (body, fundus, lower segment), cervix, vagina, fallopian tubes, ovaries and their ligaments, plus the uterine arteries and veins. Aligned to the male pelvis by similarity ICP (scale 0.845), so organ size and position are approximate. The female pelvis is not used because the set has ilium, sacrum and coccyx only, with no pubis or ischium.
